newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia OSK plans bonus, special issues.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia OSK plans bonus, special issues.

text.p: Malaysian stockbroking firm OSK Holdings Bhd said on Tuesday it was proposing a one-for-one bonus issue of up to 404.45 million new shares.

In a statement issued by its merchant bankers, OSK said it was also planning a special issue of 26.9 million new shares at a proposed price of 5.0 ringgit each to Bumiputra (ethnic Malay) shareholders.
A rights issue of up to 404.45 million nominal value five-year 4.0 percent irredeemable convertible unsecured loan stocks (ICULS) on the basis of one ICULS for one share held was also proposed.
OSK said the bonus issue would increase its issued and paid up share capital and provide existing shareholders with greater participation in the company's equity.
The special share issue was to meet the government's ruling on Bumiputra participation while the ICULS issue would provide cost efficient long-term financing for OSK.
